note: Both sets capture the core baseline figures (HabEx 4 m/52 m starshade, LUVOIR-A 15 m, LUVOIR-B 8 m, Lynx 3 m and 10 m focal length, Origins 5.9 m) and both are cluttered with duplicated and fragment-entity claims. Set B binds LUVOIR-A's 15 m diameter and HabEx's four science instruments to their named concepts, which Set A only states with vague entities ('on-axis telescope', 'spacecraft'), so A drops two important bindings. Set A additionally contains a hard misbinding — 'grazing incidence mirror assembly | diameter | 10 m' where the source gives 10 m as focal length — plus a garbled quote, while B's residual errors are garbled entity fragments ('n-axis telescope') and vague attributes ('size'/'dimension' 10 m). Neither set records Origins' three science instruments.
